title: Uniform Manufacturing Franchise Opportunity
name: Fitform, 1 Franchisee, Est'd in 2026, Madurai HQ
description: Fitform Industries Private Limited Is a Madurai-based uniform garment manufacturer established in 2026. The company manufactures and supplies uniform fabrics for schools, factories, offices and universities, while building a network of distributors and sales partners across Tamil Nadu and Kerala. The B2B model enables partners to generate uniform orders, with the company providing fabrics and production support. The franchise and distribution opportunity is aimed at investors willing to invest INR 10–15 lakh, with an expected ROI of 20 - 30%. The company provides structured training and operational support to help partners grow in the uniform and textile segment. The business has an incorporation certificate and GST certificate.
